answer: The design leans on invitation quota tree, re-queued for a second panel, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. By the sonnet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The karst holds work receipts rather than names, so the marble of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
